question.text: When a gas filled in a closed vessel is heated by raising the temperature by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo>°</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math>, its pressure increases by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>%</mo></math> The initial temperature of the gas is _____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>K</mi></math>.

solution.text:
From ideal gas equation, PV=nRT, where, n is amount of substance, R is ideal gas constant and V is volume.

In closed vessel volume remains constant.

So, dPP×100=dTT×100

0.4=1T×100

⇒T=250 K
